about: The owner's overrules of a place's derived danger (tools/newworld/place_danger.py; docs/design/danger.md): {place_id: {disposition?, strength?, reach?, reward?, why}}. A rebuild keeps them; a derived value is never written here.

outpost-m3-m60.why: owner, 2026-11-16, of an early quest's place that was too dangerous: 'either it needs to be changed to be easier ... and its area's danger band reduced (and danger band of the way to it)'. Sedge-Kal Camp opens the main plot (story/design/quests/lines/main-plot.md section 9): mudcrabs and one young crocodile, and the way in from the road held at D1 to match.

outpost-m11-m63.why: owner, 2026-11-16: 'either it needs to be changed to be easier ... and its area's danger band reduced'. Reed-Sill Weir is quest 2 of the main plot (story/design/quests/lines/main-plot.md section 9): mudcrabs and one young crocodile.

tribal-camp-m2-m68.why: owner, 2026-11-16: 'either it needs to be changed to be easier ... and its area's danger band reduced'. Karsh-Naal Camp is quest 4 of the main plot (story/design/quests/lines/main-plot.md section 9): the Unbound's hired Naga guards, with no chief.
